gloss: action before words; doing rather than talking

definitions.gloss: action before words; quietly getting things done
definitions.explanation: The attitude of doing what needs to be done quietly and steadily, without boasting or announcing it beforehand.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{不言実行|ふげんじっこう}の{人|ひと}だ。
examples.english: He is a man of action, not words.

examples.japanese: {不言実行|ふげんじっこう}をモットーにしている。
examples.english: I make "action before words" my motto.

examples.japanese: {不言実行|ふげんじっこう}で、{彼|かれ}は{文句|もんく}も{言|い}わずに{難|むずか}しい{仕事|しごと}をやり{遂|と}げた。
examples.english: True to "action over words," he completed the difficult job without a single complaint.

notes:
A four-character idiom ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) made of {不言|ふげん} (not speaking) + {実行|じっこう} (carrying out). It praises people who act quietly instead of making big declarations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不言実行|ふげんじっこう}の{人|ひと}: a person who acts without talking
- {不言実行|ふげんじっこう}を{心|こころ}がける: to aim to act rather than talk

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {有言実行|ゆうげんじっこう}: doing what one has said one will do — the modern counterpart that values declaring goals and then achieving them
- {言行一致|げんこういっち}: consistency between words and actions
